newsitem.title: USA: Teenager arrested in Tulsa abortion clinic attacks.
newsitem.headline: Teenager arrested in Tulsa abortion clinic attacks.

text.p: A 15-year-old boy was arrested Thursday in connection with three bomb and gunfire attacks at a Tulsa abortion clinic, officials said.

FBI spokesman Dan Vogel said the teenage suspect was a white male, and that police received a tip-off after releasing a composite sketch of their main suspect in the three attacks, all of which occurred this year.

Federal agents pounced on the boy's home in the Tulsa suburb of Bixby and searched for clues early Thursday. One man, one woman and an eight-year-old child were also placed in custody, but Vogel said they would be released shortly.
"We are only making one arrest today," Vogel said. "The other three will be released." He did not identify the teenage boy and declined to detail what evidence had been found at the home.

The Reproductive Services of Tulsa clinic has been attacked three times since the start of 1997. On New Year's Day, two molotov cocktails were thrown at the building and two small bombs were exploded outside the back door Jan. 19.
Last Sunday someone broke into the building and fired bullets into medical equipment.
No one was injured in the attacks as the clinic was closed for the day on all three occasions. The clinic employs 15 people and offers family planning and adoption services as well as abortions.
Vogel said the investigation was continuing and that more arrests might be made.
